You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hi guys, my downloaded songs keep getting unrecognized when I go offline. I have to keep selecting "download" and it is frustrating when I want to listen to music on a plane not having offline content. Why is this happening on my LGV10 Android?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating. Can you try re-downloading the songs after clearing the app cache? Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Doesn't address potential device-specific issues or provide detailed troubleshooting steps."}
